name: insulin like growth factor 1 receptor

function.text: IGF1R encodes insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor [Cleaved into: Insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor alpha chain; Insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor beta chain]. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and insulin receptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to growth delay due to insulin-like growth factor I resistance (autosomal dominant); growth delay due to insulin-like growth factor I resistance (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
